name: AccordionPanel
src_typeComment: Expand/collapse a content region with an animated height, driven by the EXISTING Tween engine and a LayoutElement.preferredHeight override — works inside any VerticalLayoutGroup (a FAQ list, a settings category list) since the layout group re-flows around the animating height automatically. Wiring a header click to Toggle() is left to the caller (e.g. a Button.onClick) rather than baked in here, matching this toolkit's "primitives, not opinionated" pattern.

src_serialized.name: content
src_serialized.tooltip: The collapsible body. Its natural (expanded) height is captured once, from its RectTransform's height, before any collapsing happens — make sure it's sized to its full expanded height in the scene/prefab.
